title: DevExp standup 2026-05-27
body:
Attendees: Maya, Liam, Priya, Diego (running short today), + async updates from Faizal and Olivia

Agenda:
- Quick sync on SDK release blockers
- Docs quickstart rollout plan (Python + JS)
- Samples: chat + function-calling sample updates and CI issues
- Action items and owners

Yesterday / last week highlights:
- SDK 0.8 branch: final API changes landed (PR #412). Added structured output helper and streaming fixes. Integration tests green on linux-amd64, failing on mac-arm in CI (see linked PR).
- Quickstarts: Python quickstart draft merged to docs repo; JS quickstart PR created but needs examples of streaming and tool-calls. Confluence quickstarts page updated with draft links.
- Samples: chat-with-tools sample updated to use the new KV-cache option; updated README with runbook and env vars. Demo app working locally.
- Telemetry: usage counters added to sdk telemetry for quickstart runs (counts sample-start events).

Today / next priorities:
- Maya: coordinate SDK rc build for internal demo next Wednesday. Need one more approval on the release checklist (security sign-off from S&C).
- Liam: debug mac-arm CI failures (observed segfault when running wasm-based tokenizer). Root cause suspected in tokenizer native binding; reproducing locally. ETA EOD.
- Priya: finish JS quickstart examples for streaming and function-calling, target to publish doc by Friday. Will add code snippets and downloadable sample app.
- Diego: update sample app CI to use the new caching layer; also add an integration test to assert cache hits for repeated prompts.

Blockers / Risks:
- CI instability on mac-arm prevents us from cutting rc for SDK 0.8. If unresolved, we may delay public release by 3 business days. (Owner: Liam)
- Security approval pending for telemetry changes (S&C review). If S&C requests changes, tagging may be required and could impact rollout. (Owner: Maya)
- Docs bandwidth low next week due to conference attendance (Olivia out Tue-Thu). We should postpone non-critical doc edits.

Decisions made:
- Keep SDK API backward-compatible for 0.8; provide a deprecation notice for legacy streaming flag.
- Publish Python quickstart first, JS quickstart will follow within 48 hours once samples are validated.

Action items (owners):
- Liam: finish root-cause analysis for mac-arm CI segfault; post findings in #devexp-ci and link JIRA DE-324. Due: 2026-05-27 EOD.
- Maya: request final S&C sign-off and add security notes to release checklist. Due: 2026-05-28.
- Priya: complete and open PR for JS quickstart with streaming and function-calling examples. Due: 2026-05-29.
- Diego: add integration test for cache-hit assertion in samples CI and flip caching flag on staging. Due: 2026-05-28.
- Faizal (async): verify telemetry opt-out docs are present and add example. Due: 2026-05-28.

Notes / Context / Links:
- GitHub SDK PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/412 (contains changelog and migration notes).
- Docs commit preview: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/commit/abc1234
- JIRA: DE-324 (CI mac-arm failure), DE-330 (telemetry review)
- Slack threads: #devexp (thread pinned: SDK 0.8 release notes), #devexp-ci (CI run logs)

Quick wins / reminders:
- If you rely on a Mac M1 for testing, please try to reproduce locally and attach a core dump to DE-324.
- Reminder: update the changelog _and_ the migration guide before final publish; small doc omission caused a helpdesk ticket last release.

Parking lot / Follow-ups:
- Create a small checklist for quickstart smoke tests that can be run by non-engineers (support/solutions).
- Consider adding a 'run on Gitpod' badge for the JS quickstart so external contributors can test quickly.

Next meeting: Weekly DevExp standup on 2026-06-03 10:00 PT (same Zoom).

Notes to self: push the SDK RC to the internal channel once mac-arm CI is green; otherwise call out delay publicly in #announce.
